species.real: Grey squirrels carry squirrelpox, which barely bothers them but kills red squirrels, a big reason the reds vanish wherever the greys arrive.
species.name: Grizzlet

dex.text: Hangs upside down from the bird feeder in full view of the sign that says not to. Cheerfully unbothered by anything with a pulse.
dex.fact: The grey squirrel was brought to Britain from North America in the 1870s, and it has spread widely since.

species.real: Grey squirrels sometimes pretend to bury a nut when they know they are being watched, then hide it somewhere else, a bluff called deceptive caching.
species.name: Raidtail

dex.text: Its tail is a fluffy flag of ill intent. Has raided every bird table in the postcode and will happily tell you about it.
dex.fact: Grey squirrels hide food in many small places and find lots of them again by memory and smell.
